description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_EnergyDrinkBottlingInspection" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/energy-drink-bottling-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MachineInspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Inspector" name="Inspector">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_InspectionBegins</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterMachineType</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSerialNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnswerInspectionQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PressMachineButton</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_InspectionCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Inspection Application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchMachineReadings</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckInspectionResults</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InspectionBegins" name="Inspection started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToEnterType</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineType" name="Enter machine type">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToEnterType</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterTypeToEnterSerial</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSerialNumber" name="Enter serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterTypeToEnterSerial</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterSerialToAnswerQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerInspectionQuestions" name="Answer inspection questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterSerialToAnswerQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPress</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressMachineButton" name="Press machine button">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPress</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressToFetchReadings</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FetchMachineReadings" name="Fetch readings from machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressToFetchReadings</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FetchToDisplayValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisplayMachineValues" name="Display machine values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FetchToDisplayValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisplayToCheckResults</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckInspectionResults" name="Check inspection results">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisplayToCheckResults</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckToAdditionalSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" name="Results require additional questions?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckToAdditionalSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalAnswerToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" name="Inspection questions completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalAnswerToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted" name="Inspection completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToEnterType" sourceRef="StartEvent_InspectionBegins" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterTypeToEnterSerial" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineType" targetRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterSerialToAnswerQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber" targetRef="Task_AnswerInspectionQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPress" sourceRef="Task_AnswerInspectionQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressMachineButton"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressToFetchReadings" sourceRef="Task_PressMachineButton" targetRef="Task_FetchMachineReadings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FetchToDisplayValues" sourceRef="Task_FetchMachineReadings" targetRef="Task_DisplayMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisplayToCheckResults" sourceRef="Task_DisplayMachineValues" targetRef="Task_CheckInspectionResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToAdditionalSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckInspectionResults" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalQuestionsRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalAnswerToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
